newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder June total revenue up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder June total revenue up 8 pct.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc said total operating revenue for June was up 8.0 percent to $197.775 million from $183.164 million in the same month a year ago.
Total operating revenue was up 6.0 percent for the year-to-date to $1.246 billion, from $1.175 billion a year ago, it said.
It said the the numbers and the comparisons exclude results from four newspapers acquired from Walt Disney Co on May 9.

They also exclude results, for both years, from the Business Information Services Division, except the Technimetrics unit, pending the sale of Knight-Ridder Information Inc, it said. Those results have been restated as discontinued operations, and Technimetrics' revenue was consoliated with other revenue, it said.
It said its newspapers turned in another good month, with total advertising revenue up 9.0 percent to $148.929 million from $136.599 million in the same month a year ago.
Full-run linage rose 8.2 percent for the month and 6.0 percent for the year-to-date, it said.
For the year-to-date, advertising revenue was up 7.5 percent to $938.967 million from $873.292 million in the corresponding year in 1996, it said.

It said circulation revenue was up 1.7 percent to $38.856 million from $38.208 million for the month but was down 0.3 percent to $252.059 million for the year-to-date, compared with $252.691 million for the same period in 1996.

Other revenue rose 19.5 percent for the month to $9.99 million, from $8.357 million in June 1996, due in part to increases from Technimetrics, it said. For the year-to-date, other revenue was up 11.5 percent to $54.505 million, from $48.878 million for the correspnding period a year ago, it said.
